name: Satanism
overview: Scripture reveals Satanism as a manifestation of rebellion against God, characterized by pride, deceit, and the distortion of truth, as seen in John 8:44 where the devil is described as the father of lies and a murderer from the beginning. Those who engage in occult practices or seek familiar spirits are warned against in Leviticus 19:31, reflecting God’s call to holiness and separation from defilement. The Bible also highlights God's righteous judgment against all wickedness and unrighteousness (Romans 1:18) and pronounces woe on those who invert moral realities by calling evil good and good evil (Isaiah 5:20). Ultimately, God preserves those who love Him while destroying the wicked (Psalms 145:20), underscoring the necessity of rejecting Satanic influences and embracing the truth of God.
